profile.name: SYNTHETIC diesel excavator, XE135U brochure envelope reference only
profile.note: Brochure lists 2200 rpm and a conflicting 2100 rpm label; model caps at 2100, not a calibration.

assumptions.fuel_model: fuel_lph = 1.6 + shaft_power_kw * 0.245 / 0.835 while engine on; zero off
assumptions.fuel_parameters: 1.6 L/h parasitic/intercept, 0.245 kg/kWh slope, 0.835 kg/L diesel density: assumed, not OEM curve
assumptions.thermal_model: first-order relaxation to load-dependent targets; no cooling-failure model
assumptions.hydraulic_model: single equivalent circuit; output = 0.76 * (shaft - 4kW auxiliaries); Q=600P/p
assumptions.state_model: semi-Markov excavation cycle with assumed durations and soil/operator factors
assumptions.scope: one simulated fault at a time; no physical component failures or real SPN/FMI codes
assumptions.detailed_channels: rpm/pressure/flow/temperature are simulator channels, NOT guaranteed Trackunit account fields
